title: GPU preview: today's best build plus the three GPU fixes, to try by hand
problem: You asked to try the GPU rendering fixes together in one build (T-073). Each one is checked on its own; this page puts them together so you can feel the whole page.
idea: B = today's best build plus: the countdown as static strips (cd-strip, landed), the countdown roll on the GPU (cd-roll-ca), the hero exit on the GPU (hero R2, touch phones only) and the end-of-page menu reveal on the GPU (morph-gpu, phones only). A = today's best build. Each fix's code is byte for byte the code that fix was checked with.
looksSame: Each fix was checked against today's page on its own (its own pixel checks). Here only the combination is new; the combined checks are listed under the differences.
visualDiff: Morph (Simulator, 12 frozen steps): the preview draws what morph-gpu alone draws, at most 1 colour level off, the same as loading the same page twice.
Countdown (Simulator, 42 frozen roll frames): the preview draws what the GPU countdown roll alone draws, at most 1 level off, the same as a repeat load.
Hero (Simulator, top, 300 px, 548 px): 0 pixels differ from the hero fix alone.
Chrome: no errors, no missing files; screenshots differ 0-0.22 %, the usual countdown and card-animation phase.

gain.how: This is a preview to try by hand; no timing was measured for the combination.

risk: Preview only, each fix lands on its own. Known cost: the end-of-page menu reveal (morph-gpu rev 1) makes the first frame of a repeat open about 7 ms longer on the phone, paid back the next frame; a rev 2 is coming. The GPU countdown roll has not had its phone check yet, and the hero fix still waits for its finger swipe test.
